comments.body: Highschool or highschool equivalent grades never matter in Switzerland as pretty much each school has is own educational program. I know people that had the best grade in chemistry and math from one school (known to be "easier") almost drop out from their STEM undergrad class while other were marked a whole grade lower from another school literally a few kilometer further (know to be very "hard") becoming best in their of their STEM class.
comments.author: Fit-Conclusion-7579
